verdict.rationale: A state business-filing registry could plausibly offer a test or sandbox filing environment for integrators, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The keyless Socrata open-data API is a read-only public data feed hosted on a separate platform, not an isolated test environment for filings, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
